name: SimCare
short_description: AI-powered counseling simulation platform with 500+ customizable client avatars for training therapists and behavioral health clinicians.
long_description: SimCare is an immersive counseling simulation platform that uses lifelike AI clients to help students and therapists practice clinical skills in realistic scenarios. The platform offers over 500 AI patient profiles across diverse ages, identities, presenting problems, and languages, supporting individual, group, marriage and family, school, addictions, and crisis counseling training. Features include real-time bi-directional conversations, session continuity, observational AI that provides feedback on tone, empathy, and nonverbal communication, and automated performance scoring. Used by 15,000+ students at universities, government agencies, and training organizations, SimCare is designed to accelerate clinical readiness while providing a safe space to practice complex cases across psychology, psychiatry, clinical counseling, social work, and behavioral health disciplines.
one_liner: AI simulation platform with 500+ client avatars for training behavioral health clinicians.
best_for: University programs training counselors, psychologists, and social workers
Clinical training organizations needing scalable practice scenarios
Behavioral health employers providing continuing education
Government agencies training mental health workforce
not_for: Clinical practices seeking patient-facing EHR or documentation tools
Organizations needing billing or practice management features

pricing.notes: Flexible billing options available. Institutions may pay directly or pass cost to students as lab/tech fee. Grant funding supported (Title V, HRSA, departmental budgets). Contact for demo and pricing.

compliance.notes: IT-approved security built for university data and privacy standards. No patient data processed - simulation training only.

faqs.q: What types of scenarios does SimCare support?
faqs.a: SimCare offers 500+ customizable AI client profiles supporting individual, group, marriage and family, school, addictions, and crisis counseling scenarios across diverse ages, identities, and presenting problems.
